messages:
hana: hi team, hello from my first day! set up my Mac Mini (office desk unit) and noticed Kandji shows Enrolled but Kernel Extension approvals are blocked and i cant join corp wifi. also `fdesetup status` says FileVault On but Kandji still flags "Escrow missing". need short-lived admin to complete post-enroll steps.

it-lee: welcome hana :wave: can you paste the serial and the output of `profiles status -type enrollment`? we usually grant a 90-minute temp admin. avoid reboot until we finish.

hana: serial C02MTZ98765K. `profiles status -type enrollment` -> "enrolled: true; last checkin: 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z". screenshot of Kandji uploaded. the kernel extension popup references `com.company.netext`.

mdm-sam: thanks. looks like supervision applied but the user consent for kernel ext and network extension needs a manual allow on the Security & Privacy pane. i'll push the supervised allow and a FileVault escrow job. granting temp admin for 90m now.

enroll-bot: Job queued: push_supervised_approve_7201 -> device=C02MTZ98765K
enroll-bot: Job completed: push_supervised_approve_7201 -> success

it-bot: Temporary admin granted: hana -> 90 minutes (sudo access via /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins).

hana: saw the Security & Privacy prompt, clicked Allow. still getting an OS update prompt: "macOS 13.5.2 - Required restart". should i install now or wait?

it-lee: go ahead and install while the temp admin is active. please run the update then don't force-logout from slack so we can verify the MDM checkin after reboot.

hana: update installed, rebooted. Kandji shows check-in and FileVault now says Escrowed. i can `sudo` and install brew. wifi connects. thanks!

mdm-sam: good to hear. leaving the temp admin for the remainder of the window. filing a quick follow-up ticket to investigate why the kernel extension approval didn't auto-apply for this cohort.

hana: removed test packages and local dev certs. ready to have the temp admin revoked whenever. thanks again :raised_hands:

it-bot: Temporary admin revoked: hana -> removed from /etc/sudoers.d/temp-admins. closing loop.
